bookCredit: Freedom Train: The Story of Harriet Tubman by Dorothy Sterling (1954) is quoted only in short lines.
title: The Household’s Only Treasure

banner.alt: A log cabin at night under a sky full of stars, one star brighter than the rest, with a patchwork quilt in the corner

keepsake.name: quilt square
keepsake.line: Only Imagination Trip travelers earn this one. It is pieced from scraps, green, brown and yellow, like the quilt Old Rit sewed by firelight.

body: Sterling walks us around the Ross cabin: the fireplace of sticks and mud, the potato hole, the straw beds, and one glowing quilt.
Build the room the way the chapter has it.
postcard.word: A hearth is the floor in front of a fireplace, where the pots sit and Harriet watches supper cook.

mission.p: Set up the one room of Chapter 2 the way Sterling describes it.

steps.build:
Open your menu (top button, right controller) and click Models. Build in this order:
  1. the fireplace
  2. pots and firewood by the hearth
  3. two straw beds, the blanket on one
  4. chairs and potatoes
steps.say: Stand by the quilt. Practice these 2 sentences out loud:
steps.frame: “The ___ in the cabin shows ___. I know because ___.”
steps.extra: Put a Bread Loaf by the fire: the corn bread Old Rit stirs.

points: Your video is 30 seconds or less, shows the fireplace, the beds and the blanket, and you say 2 sentences: one object, what it shows about Harriet’s family, and a detail from Chapter 2.

alt.p: Tap the moments of Chapter 2 in the order they happen.
alt.gameH: Tap the next thing that happens

events.t: Harriet sleeps a night and a day
events.s: with nightmares of children on a long rope
she says Harriet showed bad sense, and she is afraid for her
worth thirty lashes if anyone saw
no more Big House; fields instead
Harriet explains why she can’t smile at Mistress

alt.miss: Not yet. Think about what the family was doing right before this.

write.q: Pick one object in the Ross cabin. In 2 sentences, say what it shows about Harriet’s family and give one detail from Chapter 2 that proves it.

scripts.brief: Hey, it’s Marcus. In Chapter 2, Sterling takes us inside the Ross cabin and names what is there: the fireplace of sticks and mud, the potato hole, the straw beds, and the patchwork quilt that took Old Rit years to finish. Build that one room so every object sits where the chapter puts it, and then tell me what one of them shows about Harriet’s family.
scripts.alt: No headset? Pull up a chair by the fire. Chapter 2 happens in one night and one morning, and the order matters. Tap each moment in the order Sterling tells it, from Harriet’s restless sleep to the quilt and the shining star.
scripts.saved: That is the cabin, right down to the quilt. I saved you a square pieced from scraps, green and brown and yellow, like the one Old Rit made. Keep it where you will see it.

testPara: The quilt in the cabin shows the family could make something beautiful from scraps. I know because Rit collected torn dresses from the Big House for years and it was the household's only treasure.
